title: Simple Corpse
description: Basic gravestone mod in the style of a corpse with no UI or keybinds.
body: The purpose of this mod is simply to stop your items from despawning when you die. I did not like other mods dropping gravestones instead of a corpse and also all the added waypoints, guides, UI, keybinds, and whatever other various death mechanics. In mine you die, a corpse generates with all your items, and that's it. You still have to find your way back then mine your corpse to get your items. So if what you want is just a basic gravestone mod to protect your items on death, look no further. 1.2.0+ Respects player size defined by Pehkui mod. 1.6.0+ Compatible with Create Aeronautics.
